chapter: Armstrong, Parker and life inside the Basie band
title: What Armstrong told him: practice, and New York players can't all play
summary: Tate and Armstrong talked for hours about jazz; Armstrong told him to practice.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: What kind of stuff did you talk to him about?

Well, I talked to him about jazz and his experience of, you know, how did he -- you know, how had he come up playing and, you know, people he had played with, and I asked him about Chicago musicians and New York musicians, were they all great? But he had told me earlier, he says, "All the cats in New York can't play, you know." So we -- you
know, he told me, says, -- he just told me to practice, said you couldn't practice enough, almost the same thing Frankie Trumbauer told me, just practice, practice, practice, all the time, you know.
